v2.A2: Raised task success by 20% across 12 participants, from 65% to 85%, with audio landmarks and high-contrast line colors.

desc.T1: The System Usability Scale runs from 0 to 100, so a score of 104 is impossible; the figure is misreported.
desc.T2: An open card sort shows how people group content; it cannot measure whether they find items in a given navigation, which needs a tree test or task-based test.
desc.T3: WCAG 2.1 AA requires a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for body text; 3:1 is enough only for large text, so the design system does not meet AA.
desc.T4: Net Promoter Score is the percentage of promoters (9-10) minus the percentage of detractors (0-6), from -100 to 100; an average rating is not NPS.
